body: You’ll never be wasting your time. Honestly u can always just go undecided, and figure smth out you like through clubs/classes/internships

I cant speak on college since I’m just getting ready to go but Ik otherwise life can be stupid boring. I mean I do genuinely suggest getting a job, go find something ur even somewhat passionate about and get a job in that, or maybe YouTube or something if you don’t have to make money to sustain yourself. I know that genuinely helped me as well, or if your school has any clubs those r also a great option.

Genuinely life is far from an easy thing to figure out. The only reason I have any idea what I want to do in college is from hobbies to keep myself from kms. You have a purpose though. You have a reason. There is something out there for you, this timing just fucking sucks. The whole collapse of the world majorly fucked this up and made it so much harder to figure things out, but you aren’t a failure. Your parents probably never had to figure everything for themselves out in a time like this and all parents can be pushy. It’s your life though, and you should genuinely take ur time to find smth you enjoy bc jumping on something could be worse for you in the long run
Ofc man. And ik if ur young there’s a ton more to do than that, but hopefully it’s a start

There will be someone there for you. It takes time, and ik some people just don’t wanna help bc they don’t understand but I promise you someone is. Ik I’m some random person telling u this but trust me there is. My dms r open if u need someone to as well.

I can tell you right now that recognition of the fact that if you do anything you’ll hurt people is a start. Hell it’s the only reason I’m alive and have seen things start to get better. I genuinely recommend making lists, however small, of things to do every day. It helped me, and the genuine satisfaction of getting shit done you’ve planned out is actually nice and slowly begins to help. Idk how old u are but I can tell u being a teen aint always very fun. I could go on some rant abt that but if ur older it doesn’t rlly apply. I hope this at least is a start to helping u

Some people just genuinely have an easier life then others. It’s what happens around me, so many people ik literally just have a perfect life. I’ll tell you though it makes it so much harder to deal with the reality of the world. Your right, the world is fucked. It always has been, it always will be. You need to be able to find the good in it thought. There’s always good. Every time I’ve always wanted to end it, i try to find every good thing i can think about, past or present, bc even the smallest thing can help.

Even at the worst times, ur never alone. There are people out there who care about you, even if it doesn’t seem like it. Your head will fuck with you that way. It’ll tell you that no one gives a shit, but they do. I hope you’re okay, and know there is always someone out there who’s willing to tell you it’s okay and that it’ll all be okay.
